title: BRAND NAME OEM EATON/DANFOSS POWER SOLUTIONS MAIN ENGINE CLUTCH AND COUPLING PARTS
agency: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEPT OF THE NAVY.NAVSUP.NAVSUP GLOBAL LOGISTICS SUPPORT.NAVSUP FLC PUGET SOUND.NAVSUP FLT LOG CTR PUGET SOUND
description_text: NAVSUP Fleet Logistics Center Puget Sound intends to solicit and award a firm-fixed-price Supply-type Purchase Order for OEM EATON CORPORATION/DANFOSS POWER SOLUTIONS on a BRAND NAME basis. See attached solicitation posted 1 APR 2026 for requirements. All responses shall be submitted prior to the solicitation closing date on page 1, box 8
